subsection.title: Demo Scenario
subsection.description: - Automatically generate the shortest executable scenario that covers every approved Required Acceptance Test at least once. - Reuse shared setup and actions when the tests form one coherent flow. Use separate execution blocks inside this subsection when connecting them would require an unapproved product behavior. - For every step, state the user action, visible expected result, and the required test it covers. - Show the complete generated scenario and its test coverage before asking for approval. - End with one overall pass result that requires every Required Acceptance Test to pass. - Keep tested claims inside the approved Overview, Solution and Acceptance Tests, and explicit Out of Scope boundary. - Treat a passing demo as evidence that the approved product behavior runs, not as proof of user value or market validity. - Do not ask the user to rewrite a demo flow when the approved tests already contain executable starting conditions, actions, and pass conditions. - Do not omit a required test or invent product behavior merely to connect the steps.
subsection.example:
**Starting state:** The learner has no saved expressions and opens the practice workspace.
**Demo input:** `break the ice`
| Step | User action | Visible expected result | Covers required test | |------|-------------|-------------------------|----------------------| | 1 | Enters `break the ice` | Practice questions appear for `break the ice` | Expression-specific questions appear | | 2 | Answers the questions | The result appears and `break the ice` is saved | The practice result is saved | | 3 | Opens the expression list | `break the ice` appears in the saved list | The saved expression is available later |
**Overall pass result:** All three Required Acceptance Tests pass: questions appear for `break the ice`, the completed practice is saved, and the saved expression is visible in the list.
